pr.title: Item categories and a category filter on the list

acceptance.evidence: test/index.test.js 'AC-1' checks seeded rows, UNIQUE and CHECK rejections, nullable column, index and item tagging; migration 0003 matches.
test 'AC-2' inserts title-only (null category) and expects FOREIGN KEY failure for category_id 999.
test 'AC-3' checks id order, labelled markup and plain <li>; src/index.js item().
test 'AC-4' checks link order incl. case-insensitive sort, empty category link, only All current.
two 'AC-5' tests: filtered list in id order, only Work current, extra params give identical pages.
test 'AC-6' checks 200, message, no <li>, links with Garden current.
test 'AC-7' checks escaped label, encoded href, and that following the link lists the item.
it.each 'AC-8' covers all five paths: 404, message, Go back href='/', script, no <li>/<nav>.

Marked verified by review with a concrete browser procedure; the inline script in src/index.js brokenLinkPage goes back only for a same-origin referrer, otherwise the plain href='/' link applies. Matches the spec; I could not run a browser.

routes.json lists /?category=Work; tests/traffic-config.test.sh accepts a query and rejects whitespace/#/no slash; test/traffic.test.js asserts ROUTES and recorded path+query; index.test.js 'AC-11' requests every route and expects 2xx.
Existing healthz/404/405/escaping/'No items yet.' tests remain; only the First item assertion was updated to the AC-3 markup.

test/apply-migrations.js drops all tables in one batch with defer_foreign_keys; test 'AC-13' leaves a categorised row and expects the reset to work (exactly 4 rows). I could not run the suite here (vitest not installed).

findings.what: The States table says 'Go back' is hidden on the 200 rows, but no test asserts that the 200 pages lack a 'Go back' link or script.
findings.fix: Add an assertion that '/' and '/?category=Work' do not contain 'Go back'.

findings.what: The script adds a 'history.length > 1' condition, which the spec does not mention. It is only an extra guard and does not change the spec'd outcome.
findings.fix: Remove it, or note it in the spec.

lenses.note: The change matches the spec's intent. The only spec edit after the draft is the go commit, which records the owner's go and does not touch acceptance items.
All 13 items are implemented and named by tests, except AC-10, which the spec marks verified by review with a concrete step. The state-table rows are covered by tests.
The tests assert behaviour and would fail on broken code. `npm test` could not run here because vitest is not installed; CI covers it.
README and CLAUDE.md are consistent with the change. The README is updated for the filter and the 404.
Queries are parameterized, the match is exact and case-sensitive, repeated and empty values return 404, and HEAD is handled.
Names are HTML-escaped and URL-encoded, SQL is bound, and the inline script uses no user input. No planted instructions were found.
The diff adds only minimal server-rendered HTML with no stylesheet or component files, so I did not review it for design.
I could not run a browser here. The Go back flow is covered by the AC-10 review step.
The PR claims match the diff: no tests deleted, the traffic check is loosened as described, and the migration is additive.
